# Bauhaus

Geometric order, primary color, and confident functional hierarchy.

## Use

Use for design education, clear process stories, and bold editorial pages.

## Essential traits

- Primary geometric accents
- Strong grid
- Functional hierarchy

## Typography

Bold system sans-serif headings with geometric spacing.

## Layout and surfaces

Asymmetric geometry balanced by a strict alignment grid. Circle and rectangle accents in red, blue, and yellow outside text.

## Palette

- background: #f3efde
- surface: #fffdf1
- text: #242821
- muted: #58604e
- accent: #a52e27
- border: #a6ad94

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Bauhaus to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Bold system sans-serif headings with geometric spacing. Asymmetric geometry balanced by a strict alignment grid. Circle and rectangle accents in red, blue, and yellow outside text. Palette: background #f3efde, surface #fffdf1, text #242821, muted #58604e, accent #a52e27, border #a6ad94. Essential traits: Primary geometric accents; Strong grid; Functional hierarchy. Avoid: Uncontrolled asymmetry; Shapes covering data; Primary colors used as status alone. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
